scope: Follow the first-start guide using a source-only ZIP and an isolated local user profile on the same Windows PC.

regression.skip_reason: Windows target-symlink test requires symlink creation privileges.

release_followups: Superseded on 2026-11-14: all 48 source records are documented in model-sources.json. See MODEL-LICENSES.md for separate license conditions and unresolved full texts.
New and modified source files have not been committed or published by this review. Download and check the actual remote release ZIP after publishing the reviewed files.
A second physical computer and other GPU/driver combinations have not been tested.
Quark files were listed remotely but were not all redownloaded and SHA256-verified from the public share.
Actual Yike account registration/authorization requires a user and was not automated.

Current per-mode results and remaining cases are in generation-validation.json. GPU tests were deferred on user request to prioritize production tasks; this is not a claim that all inference modes passed.
